incidents.cause: The deployed start.bat invoked java while the scheduled-task PATH had no Java directory.
incidents.resolution: Use the versioned managed runner with machine HECHAO_JAVA_HOME set to E:\jdk.

incidents.cause: Paperclip remained in the Mojang server-core download while the owl5 network made no progress.
incidents.resolution: Install the verified official Minecraft 1.21.11 server core into the Paperclip cache.

incidents.cause: The deployed paper-global.yml left proxies.velocity disabled and its secret empty.
incidents.resolution: Enable Velocity modern forwarding and inject the matching existing host secret without exposing it.

knownWarnings: Emotecraft logged one three-line proxy payload-size banner; no other activity ERROR lines were present.
remainingAcceptance: Join through the Hechao launcher and production Velocity using a licensed player account and a fresh launch grant.
Validate the Velocity plugin-message payload setting before using large Emotecraft payloads.
